name: gallbladder_review_schema_v1
description: Research-grade evidence review schema for gallbladder disease, gallstones, cholecystectomy, and post-operative recovery. This schema supports literature triage, extraction, and graph review only.
excluded_uses: causation determination for an individual case
review_questions: Which presentations of gallbladder and gallstone disease are studied, and how are symptomatic, asymptomatic, and complicated disease distinguished?
What does the literature report for conservative management, medical dissolution therapy, and drainage compared with cholecystectomy?
Which cholecystectomy approaches, timings, and intraoperative safety strategies are associated with which complication rates?
What recovery trajectories are reported after gallbladder removal, including pain, length of stay, return to work, and quality of life?
What persistent or new symptoms are reported after cholecystectomy, such as post-cholecystectomy syndrome or bile-acid diarrhoea, and what mechanisms are proposed?
Which patient, disease, and perioperative factors are reported as predictors of poorer outcomes, and at what level of evidence?
